title: Pure Legendary Planet
summary: The Yu-Gi-Oh! GX manga Legendary Planet series, uniting the eight legal Level 8 planetary boss monsters with Trade-In, Mausoleum of the Emperor, and Rank 8 Xyz Monsters. Because every main-deck Legendary Planet is Level 8, Trade-In turns extra Planets in hand into two-card draws while stocking the GY for The Blazing Mars and Call of the Haunted.

summary.title: Starters
points: Trade-In discards any Level 8 Legendary Planet (Mars, Uranus, Pluto, Venus, Mercury, Jupiter, or Saturn) to draw two cards and load the GY with monsters.
Mausoleum of the Emperor (searched by Terraforming) lets you Normal Summon any Level 8 Legendary Planet without Tributing by paying 2000 LP.
The Monarchs Stormforth lets you Tribute a monster the opponent controls to Tribute Summon a Legendary Planet, triggering the Tribute Summon effects of The Despair Uranus and The Tripper Mercury.

summary.title: Opening: Trade-In + Mausoleum of the Emperor or The Despair Uranus
steps: Activate Trade-In to discard a Level 8 Planet (such as The Blazing Mars) and draw two cards.

If you control no Spells/Traps, Tribute Summon The Despair Uranus (using The Monarchs Stormforth going second) to Set Call of the Haunted directly from your Deck, or activate Mausoleum of the Emperor and pay 2000 LP to Normal Summon Splendid Venus or The Suppression Pluto.

Once three other monsters are in your GY, banish them to Special Summon The Blazing Mars from your hand or GY, then keep both Level 8s on the field or overlay them into Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy or Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star.

summary.title: The Planetary Bosses
points: The Despair Uranus (2900 ATK) Sets a Continuous Spell or Continuous Trap (Call of the Haunted) from the Deck on Tribute Summon while you control no Spells/Traps, gains 300 ATK per face-up Continuous Spell/Trap, and prevents face-up Spells/Traps you control from being destroyed.
Splendid Venus (2800 ATK) weakens all non-Fairy monsters by 500 ATK/DEF and makes the activations and effects of your Spells and Traps unable to be negated.
The Suppression Pluto (2600 ATK) declares a card name to inspect the opponent's hand and, on a hit, permanently steals an opposing monster or destroys and steals an opposing Spell/Trap.

The Grand Jupiter discards two cards to equip an opposing monster to itself and Special Summons it to your field in the End Phase, The Tripper Mercury switches all monsters to Attack Position on Tribute Summon and attacks twice, and The Big Saturn boosts itself by 1000 ATK and deals 2800 burn when destroyed.

summary.title: Extra Deck & Payoff
points: The Blazing Mars banishes three monsters from the GY to Special Summon itself, fueling Rank 8 Xyz plays with Hope Harbinger, Dingirsu, and Coach King Giantrainer (Note: Mars's self-summon locks you out of other Special Summons for the rest of the turn, so summon it last or use it on the next turn for Rank 8s).
Elemental HERO Terra Firma represents Planet Earth in the Extra Deck alongside the Rank 8 toolbox.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The Tyrant Neptune is Forbidden in the TCG.

allow.Mausoleum of the Emperor: Field Spell that lets you Normal Summon any Level 7 or 8 Legendary Planet (Pluto, Uranus, Venus, Saturn, Jupiter, or Mercury!) without Tributing monsters by paying 1000 or 2000 LP.
allow.Trade-In: Every single main Legendary Planet is a Level 8 monster—allowing Trade-In to discard any of them to draw 2 cards while putting 3 monsters into the GY so The Blazing Mars can immediately Special Summon itself!
allow.The Monarchs Stormforth: Quick-Play Spell that lets you Tribute 1 monster your opponent controls to Tribute Summon any Legendary Planet (specifically triggering The Despair Uranus and The Tripper Mercury's Tribute Summon effects!).
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Mausoleum of the Emperor.
allow.Call of the Haunted: Continuous Trap that can be Set directly from your Deck by The Despair Uranus to revive Pluto, Venus, or Jupiter from your GY!
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 Galaxy/Space Dragon Xyz summoned using any two Level 8 Legendary Planets that negates Spells and redirects attacks.
allow.Coach King Giantrainer: Rank 8 Xyz made with three Level 8 Legendary Planets that draws up to 3 cards.
allow.Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star: Rank 8 Xyz made with two Level 8 Legendary Planets that sends an opponent's card to the GY and protects your board from destruction.

main: The Blazing Mars

Level 8 FIRE Pyro Planet (2600 ATK): while in your hand or GY, banishes 3 other monsters from your GY (loaded via Trade-In!) to Special Summon itself, and sends all other monsters you control to the GY to burn your opponent for 500 each.
The Despair Uranus

Level 8 LIGHT Rock Planet (2900 ATK): when Tribute Summoned while you control no Spells/Traps, declares Continuous Spell or Continuous Trap and sets 1 directly from your Deck; gains 300 ATK per face-up Continuous Spell/Trap and makes them indestructible!
The Suppression Pluto

Level 8 DARK Fiend Planet (2600 ATK): once per turn declares 1 card name and looks at your opponent's hand; if they have the declared card, takes permanent control of 1 monster your opponent controls OR destroys 1 Spell/Trap they control and Sets it to your field!
Splendid Venus
Level 8 LIGHT Fairy Planet (2800 ATK): all non-Fairy monsters on the field lose 500 ATK and DEF, and the activation and effects of Spell/Trap Cards you control CANNOT be negated!
The Tripper Mercury

Level 8 WATER Aqua Planet (2000 ATK): when Tribute Summoned, switches all monsters on the field to face-up Attack Position; can be Tribute Summoned with 3 Tributes to reduce all opponent's monsters' ATK by their original ATK, and can attack twice each Battle Phase!
The Grand Jupiter

Level 8 DARK Warrior Planet (2500 ATK): discards 2 cards once per turn to equip 1 face-up monster your opponent controls to itself (gaining that monster's original ATK!), and Special Summons the equipped monster to your field during the End Phase!
The Big Saturn
Level 8 DARK Machine Planet (2800 ATK): discards 1 card and pays 1000 LP to gain 1000 ATK until the End Phase; when destroyed by an opponent's card effect, both players take 2800 burn damage.
Trade-In
Core consistency engine: because Pluto, Uranus, Mars, Venus, Mercury, Jupiter, and Saturn are ALL Level 8, Trade-In discards any of them to draw 2 cards while loading the GY for The Blazing Mars!
Mausoleum of the Emperor
Pays 2000 LP instead of Tributing 2 monsters to Normal Summon Pluto, Venus, Jupiter, or Saturn directly from your hand.
The Monarchs Stormforth
Lets you Tribute an opponent's monster to Tribute Summon The Despair Uranus or The Tripper Mercury.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Mausoleum of the Emperor.
Call of the Haunted
Continuous Trap that can be Set directly from your Deck by The Despair Uranus (which also makes Call of the Haunted indestructible!) to revive Pluto, Venus, or Jupiter from your GY!
extra: Level 8 EARTH Warrior Fusion Planet (representing Planet Earth; 2500 ATK): the planetary boss of Earth from the GX manga.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Rank 8 Xyz (2 Level 8 monsters: The Blazing Mars + any Level 8 Planet) that negates Spell activations and attaches them as material.
Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star
Rank 8 Xyz (2 Level 8 Legendary Planets) that sends an opponent's card to the GY without targeting and detaches 1 material to protect your Planets from destruction.
Rank 8 Xyz (3 Level 8 Legendary Planets) that draws up to 3 cards.
